webhooks.detail: Event Webhook POSTs email events (deliverability + engagement) to developer URL; manageable via Webhooks API; signed webhooks/OAuth supported; retries up to 24h

evidence.quote: The SendGrid Event Webhook sends email event data as SendGrid processes it.

sandbox.detail: Free trial (100 emails/day for 60 days, no credit card) plus mail_settings sandbox_mode to validate send requests without delivery. Sandbox mode only validates; no real events. Free tier status per pricing page is a trial, not permanent free plan.

evidence.quote: Free trial lets you send 100 emails/day for 60 days

rate_limits.summary: Per-endpoint fixed requests per refresh period; HTTP 429 when exceeded; X-RateLimit-* headers (e.g. Email Activity API 6 req/min per changelog)

evidence.quote: If you exceed that limit, the API returns an HTTP `429` (Too Many Requests) status code.
SendGrid maintains the following official libraries for mail sending.
Files can be found in the json/ and yaml/ directories.
